view.title: Collection
view.empty: No card agrees with the filters.
view.emptyCollection: Your collection has no cards. Open a location to add cards.

settings.title: Advanced collection
settings.description: Select the optional fields of the entries. Reliquary hides the other fields and keeps their values.

locations.title: Locations
locations.empty: You have no location. Create your first location.
locations.sectionHint: A section is a part of a location, for example a box in a rack. A section has the kind of its location.
locations.deleteConfirm: Delete the location "{{name}}" and its sections?

location.lockedNotice: This location is locked. Unlock the location to change its content.
location.deckNotice: This location is an assembled deck. Change the deck to change its cards.
location.notPickableNotice: This location is not pickable. Its cards are not available cards.
location.addHint: Select a card in the list, then add it.
location.showSections: Show the cards of the sections
location.suggestion: A storage rule suggests this location for the card: {{location}}.
location.suggestionHere: A storage rule suggests this location for the card.
location.selected_one: {{count}} entry selected. The movement takes all its copies.
location.selected_other: {{count}} entries selected. The movement takes all their copies.

rules.title: Storage rules
rules.description: A storage rule suggests a location for a new card. Write a card search, for example "c:u" for the blue cards. The rule with the lowest priority number applies first.

movements.title: Movements
movements.empty: No movement agrees with the filters.

inventory.title: Inventory of {{name}}
inventory.countHint: Give the number of copies that you count for each card. Add the cards that the list does not contain.
inventory.noDifference: The count agrees with the location.
inventory.groupOrigin: Origin of all the added cards
inventory.groupDestination: Destination of all the removed cards
inventory.applied: Reliquary applied the inventory. The location has the counted content.

exchange.title: Import and export
exchange.noLocation: You have no location. Create a location, then import the file.
exchange.fileHint: Select a file, or paste the list in the field below.
exchange.currencyHint: Reliquary uses this currency for a purchase price that has no currency in the file.
exchange.errors: Reliquary ignored these lines. Correct them, then import them again:
exchange.warnings: Reliquary added these lines with a change:
exchange.includeSections: Include the cards of the sections

exportHints.text: The file contains the quantity, the name, the printing and the finish. A comment line gives the name of each location.
exportHints.csv: The file contains all the fields that you enabled, and the location of each card.
exportHints.dek: The file contains the quantity and the name of each card.
exportHints.mtga: The file contains the quantity, the name and the printing of each card.
exportHints.mtgo: The file contains the quantity and the name of each card.
exportHints.moxfield: The collection file of Moxfield. It contains the printing, the language, the finish, the condition and the purchase price.
exportHints.archidekt: The file contains the quantity, the name, the printing and the finish of each card.
exportHints.deckbox: The file contains the printing, the language, the finish and the condition of each card.
exportHints.manabox: The file contains the printing, the language, the finish, the condition and the purchase price of each card.
exportHints.dragonshield: The file contains the printing, the language, the finish, the condition, the purchase price, the entry date and the location of each card.

lineCodes.quantity_out_of_range: Line {{line}}: the quantity must be from 1 to 100,000. "{{text}}"
lineCodes.invalid_file: Line {{line}}: Reliquary cannot read the file. "{{text}}"
lineCodes.missing_column: Line {{line}}: the file has no column for the card names. Use the column "Name". "{{text}}"
lineCodes.card_not_found: Line {{line}}: no card has this name. "{{text}}"
lineCodes.unknown_language: Line {{line}}: the language is not known. "{{text}}"
lineCodes.unknown_condition: Line {{line}}: the condition is not known. "{{text}}"
lineCodes.invalid_price: Line {{line}}: the purchase price or its currency is not correct. "{{text}}"

lineCodes.note_too_long: Line {{line}}: the note has more than 500 characters. "{{text}}"

lineCodes.other: Line {{line}}: the line is not correct. "{{text}}"
